articles.title: UK Sanctions Israeli Settlement Firms, Gaza Aid Blockers in Blow to Netanyahu’s West Bank Push
articles.description: The UK has sanctioned eight Israeli construction and property firms involved in settlement activity in the West Bank, saying the measures are intended to cut off funding for further expansion. The sanctions also target an Israeli activist group accused of blocking humanitarian aid convoys into Gaza. London says the move is aimed at protecting the two-state solution, as a key deadline approaches for bids on the controversial E1 development, which could separate the West Bank from East Jerusalem.

The show has outshined Joe Rogan and Steven Bartlett, boasting over 22 million subscribers on YouTube. Originating from a modest room in Indore, Shamani now oversees a team of over 120, delving into diverse themes beyond entrepreneurship. His podcast continues to grow its global presence within the media landscape.

articles.title: 'China deal good for Canada': Carney defends Beijing auto investment as Trump trade war continues
articles.description: Prime minister of Canada, Mark Carney, said the country could turn to Chinese automakers if trade negotiations with the US president, Donald Trump, failed to preserve an integrated North American auto industry. Carney’s comments in Cambodia on Monday came ahead of a planned meeting with Chinese leader Xi Jinping this week in Shenzhen, China, where auto manufacturing is expected to be discussed. The two leaders reached an agreement in January allowing tens of thousands of Chinese electric vehicles into Canada at reduced tariffs.
